title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins manage federated Copilot connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, administration paths, licensing and preview automation are supported. It correctly distinguishes the administration change's unstated arrival default from connector availability defaults and reports the conflicting Microsoft documentation about roles and write actions.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 501584 describes administering federated Copilot connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center. #copilotcontrolsystem
